name: Super Choukyoushi J ~Nerawareta Kouen Shimai~
original_name: スーパー調教師J～狙われた公園姉妹～
source: J can train any girl into the perfect sexual partner to the amazement of men around him. Now he's given an all new challenge. Can he use his powers of sexual prowess and seduction to train two innocent elementary school girls Ayu and Yamame?
